items.name: Arnold Classic Africa 2018

venue.name: Sandton Convention Centre
venue.address: 161 Maude St, Sandown, Sandton, 2031, South Africa

items.information: ### General Information This competition will take place as part of the Arnold Classic Sport Festival. Please note that the venue will probably be quite noisy. ### Payment Competitors who register on the WCA website at least 14 days before the competition will be granted free access to the expo and will only have to pay the competition entry fee. The entrance fee is R 100 at the competition or R 85 if paid online in advance. Please see the [Payment Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArnoldClassicAfrica2018#3955-payment-information) tab for details. ### Volunteering If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact one of the WCA delegates. Please state which dates and times you will be available. Volunteer schedules will be drawn up so that they don't clash with your competing.

items.information: There is a limit of 300 competitors. There is a registration fee of $50. Spectators are welcome to attend free of charge. Schedule: https://goo.gl/qHHGmc

items.name: YJ Fest 2018
items.information: The registration will close on May 6, 23:59 or when we reach 400 competitors. Please don't forget to check e-mails for important messages from organization team. You can learn more on competition's [VK Page](https://vk.com/yjfest)
